newsitem.title: USA: US March T-bond futures climb one point after data.
newsitem.headline: US March T-bond futures climb one point after data.

text.p: U.S. March Treasury bond futures climbed one point to 111-13/32 in morning trade, boosted by technical buying after an early round of economic data.

March T-bonds climbed above resistance at 110-28/32, the 50-percent retracement of the September to December 1996 rally, and above 111-5/32, the 100-day moving average. Breaching those levels encouraged bulls who had been dormant during recent price declines, brokers said.
